description.zh: 新开的文件夹窗口并到已经开着的资源管理器里，成为一个标签页。需要 Windows 11 22H2 或更新
description.en: A folder that opens in a new File Explorer window becomes a tab of the window already open. Needs Windows 11 22H2 or newer

description.zh: 新开的文件夹窗口是否并成标签页；暂停、恢复
description.en: Whether new folder windows become tabs; pause, resume

title.zh: 新开的文件夹窗口并成标签页

hint.zh: 按住 Ctrl+Shift 打开就是新窗口
hint.en: Hold Ctrl+Shift while opening to get a window

title.zh: 文件夹已经开着就切过去
title.en: Go to a tab already showing the folder

hint.zh: 不再多开一个一样的标签页
hint.en: No second tab for the same folder

title.zh: 这些程序打开的仍是新窗口
title.en: Programs that still get a window

hint.zh: 程序名用分号隔开，例如 WindowsTerminal.exe;cmd.exe。在资源管理器里按 Ctrl+N、选“在新窗口中打开”，本来就是新窗口
hint.en: Program names separated by semicolons, e.g. WindowsTerminal.exe;cmd.exe. Ctrl+N and “Open in new window” in File Explorer always give a window
